overview: The Resonance Gardens are harmonic civic spaces shaped by void‑arcane resonance and Luclinite horticulture.
history: Created to provide Akhevan citizens a place of ritual tranquility.
Crystal‑rooted flora were cultivated to stabilize environmental resonance.
Resonance pools added to amplify harmonic void‑arcane frequencies.
Praesertum decrees formalized the Gardens as civic ritual grounds.
Modern Gardens serve as both sanctuary and ceremonial alignment space.
hooks: Crystal‑rooted flora begin emitting anomalous void signatures.
Caretakers request assistance with a corrupted arboretum echo.
A Praesertum ritual requires environmental alignment.
